name: Catnapped!
source:
"Catnapped!" is a rather silly kinetic visual novel about the dastardly cat princess and a brave rabbit on a quest to stop her!

[From [url=https://ekkoberry.itch.io/catnapped]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“被猫抓了！”是一部相当愚蠢的动态视觉小说，讲述了卑鄙的猫公主和勇敢的兔子试图阻止她！

[来自[url=https://ekkoberry.itch.io/catnapped]itch.io[/url]]
